messages:
lee: Pushing a small docs PR for the private/VPC install checklist. Main additions: firewall rule matrix, offline installer checksum steps, and a tiny PKCS#11 troubleshooting appendix. github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1290 :wave:
ana: thanks. Can you include the minimal iptables -> nftables translation example? Some customers are running mixed systems and get tripped up.
lee: added a short snippet. Example showing equivalent rules:
```
# iptables (legacy)
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8443 -j ACCEPT

# nftables (new)
nft add rule inet filter input tcp dport 8443 accept
```
pat: also add a note that some cloud VPC firewalls require both security group and NACL updates for inbound/outbound when peering. Had a support case where only SG was updated and E2E failed.
lee: added SG + NACL checklist item. Also included the minimal tcp ports matrix we use in deploy docs: 22, 443, 8443, 9000-9010 (cluster internal), and 162 (snmp/monitoring optional).
infra-bot: CI: docs lint passed for files changed in pull request 1290.
nana: for the offline installer, can you add the SHA256 verification example and an scp fallback for air-gapped hosts? Make the command precise.
lee: yep. Added this exact example: `curl -fLsS -o images.tar.gz https://artifacts.infra.redwood/release-2026-02/images.tar.gz && curl -fLsS -o images.tar.gz.sha256 https://artifacts.infra.redwood/release-2026-02/images.tar.gz.sha256 && sha256sum -c images.tar.gz.sha256` and fallback: `scp user@mirror:/tmp/images.tar.gz /tmp/ && sha256sum -c /tmp/images.tar.gz.sha256`
docs-reviewer: small wording nit: in the KMS section we say "expose TLS certs to the HSM plugin"  that's ambiguous. Suggest: "configure KMS to present a certificate signed by the customer's root CA and limit private key access to KMS host only."
lee: good phrasing, replaced it. I also added a short vendor example for YubiHSM and a troubleshooting one-liner using openssl: `openssl s_client -connect kms.internal:8443 -servername kms.internal -showcerts` so customers can validate TLS handshake + SNI.
pat: ok. For PKCS#11 troubleshooting, include the package-level check we run: `pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/pkcs11/libykcs11.so -L` and a short note that path differences are common on vendor packages.
lee: added that exact command and a tiny shell snippet to search common paths: `for p in /usr/lib/*/pkcs11* /usr/local/lib/*pkcs11*; do [ -f "$p" ] && echo "found $p"; done`
nana: can we also add a short blurb about systemd socket activation for the kms-proxy? Some customers asked for a low-cpu startup option.
lee: added a one-paragraph example and pasted a minimal systemd socket+service pair. kept it terse.
pat: LGTM. Please backport a short note into the migration checklist (1-line) so sales/solutions can copy it.
lee: will do after merge. Marked PR as docs:review and requested @ana and @pat. Thanks everyone.
infra-bot: PR 1290: label set to docs-review. 2 reviewers requested: @ana, @pat.
lee: merging after green CI unless you flag anything else in the next hour.
